designNotes: BVA on the session count at the tier edges (1, 10, 11 within the configured tiers) and an out-of-range count.
Exception price: a price different from the tier -> flagged, cannot be activated until approved.

cases.title: The tier unit price, end date and name follow the session count

steps.action: Open a new PT contract and type 24 sessions
steps.expected: Unit price, total and end date come from the PT tier for 24; the name reads "PT 24 buổi"

steps.action: Change the count to the first count of the next tier
steps.expected: The unit price changes to the next tier's price
steps.testData: first count of the next tier

cases.title: A count above the highest tier is refused

steps.action: Type one more session than the highest tier allows
steps.expected: No price is computed and the contract cannot be created

assumptions: The sources do not say what happens above the highest tier; refusing is the reading of BR-301 (price only from a tier).

cases.title: A price different from the tier makes an exception price that waits for approval

steps.action: Switch on "Giá ngoại lệ", type a price below the tier and no reason, then save
steps.expected: The save is refused until a reason is given
The contract is flagged "Exception price" and stays pending; it cannot be activated

testConditions: price != tier -> exception, reason required, pending approval
